company.name: weweb
company.shortDescription: WeWeb is an AI-powered, full-stack builder for business-critical apps
company.description:
WeWeb is an AI-powered, full-stack visual development platform built for people with a clear product idea who can't or don't want to write code. Users describe the SaaS, internal tool, or website they want, and WeWeb's AI generates the complete foundation: frontend, backend, and authentication. From there, everything is customizable through a visual, drag-and-drop editor. Re-prompting optional.

WeWeb supports both a native backend (Postgres database, auth, storage, and workflows) and integrations with external backends like Supabase and Xano, giving teams flexibility rather than lock-in. Finished applications can be hosted directly on WeWeb or exported as standard Vue.js code and self-hosted anywhere.

WeWeb serves agencies and freelance developers building client work, enterprise teams shipping internal tools, and non-technical founders building products from scratch. The platform is GDPR compliant, with unlimited users on seat-based pricing rather than per-user fees.
